## Controller Metrics

Metric families declared by the `agent-sandbox-controller` for its metrics endpoint. The Go
runtime, process, and `controller-runtime` metrics that every controller-runtime manager exposes
are not listed here.

| Metric | Type | Help | Labels |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent_sandbox_build_info` | Gauge | Agent sandbox controller build metadata exposed as labels with a constant value of 1. | `build_date`, `compiler`, `git_commit`, `git_version`, `go_version`, `platform` |
| `agent_sandbox_claim_controller_startup_latency_ms` | Histogram | Latency from the controller first observing the SandboxClaim to the claim reaching Ready in milliseconds. | `launch_type`, `sandbox_template` |
| `agent_sandbox_claim_creation_total` | Counter | Total number of Sandboxes created or adopted for a SandboxClaim. | `namespace`, `sandbox_template`, `launch_type`, `warmpool_name`, `pod_condition`, `created_by` |
| `agent_sandbox_claim_startup_latency_ms` | Histogram | End-to-end latency from a mutating admission webhook first observing the SandboxClaim (the agents.x-k8s.io/webhook-first-observed-at annotation) to the claim reaching Ready in milliseconds. Note: Only recorded for claims carrying that annotation. | `launch_type`, `sandbox_template` |
| `agent_sandbox_client_claim_startup_latency_ms` | Histogram | End-to-end latency from the client-recorded request time (the agents.x-k8s.io/client-first-requested-at annotation) to the claim reaching Ready in milliseconds. Note: Only recorded for claims carrying that annotation, and may be affected by clock skew between the client and controller. | `launch_type`, `sandbox_template` |
| `agent_sandbox_creation_latency_ms` | Histogram | Latency from Sandbox creation to its first transition to Ready in milliseconds; source timestamps have second-level Kubernetes precision. Sandboxes in the controller's initial inventory are excluded, so startups spanning restarts, upgrades, or leader failover may be omitted. Readiness flaps do not record another sample. For warm-pool sandboxes, observed at pool-member Ready (including unclaimed pool sandboxes), not at claim adoption. | `namespace`, `launch_type`, `sandbox_template` |
| `agent_sandbox_expired_total` | Counter | Total number of Sandboxes that reached their spec.shutdownTime and expired. Note: SandboxClaim lifecycle expiry is not counted. | `namespace`, `sandbox_template`, `owned_by`, `shutdown_policy` |
| `agent_sandbox_finished_total` | Counter | Total number of Sandboxes whose backing Pod reached a terminal phase (Finished=True). | `namespace`, `sandbox_template`, `owned_by`, `reason` |
| `agent_sandbox_resume_latency_ms` | Histogram | Latency from the controller first observing operatingMode=Running (after a fully-suspended state) to Sandbox Ready, in milliseconds. Note: Not recorded across controller restarts or leader changes, or for transitions that complete in the pass that starts them. | `namespace`, `sandbox_template`, `owned_by` |
| `agent_sandbox_resume_total` | Counter | Total number of Sandbox resume lifecycle events by result (requested: resume initiated from Suspended=True; ready: Sandbox reached Ready=True; error: resume hit an error reason, counted at most once per resume). Note: ready and error are not recorded across controller restarts or leader changes. | `namespace`, `sandbox_template`, `owned_by`, `result` |
| `agent_sandbox_suspend_latency_ms` | Histogram | Latency from the controller first observing operatingMode=Suspended to the Sandbox reaching Suspended=True (PodTerminated), in milliseconds. Note: Not recorded across controller restarts or leader changes, or for transitions that complete in the pass that starts them. | `namespace`, `sandbox_template`, `owned_by` |
| `agent_sandbox_suspend_total` | Counter | Total number of Sandbox suspend lifecycle events by result (requested: suspend initiated; pod_terminated: backing Pod terminated and Suspended=True reached; error: suspend hit an error reason, counted at most once per suspend). Note: pod_terminated and error are not recorded across controller restarts or leader changes. | `namespace`, `sandbox_template`, `owned_by`, `result` |
| `agent_sandbox_warmpool_size` | Gauge | Number of sandboxes currently in each warm pool, labeled by sandbox status. | `namespace`, `warmpool_name`, `sandbox_template`, `sandbox_status` |
| `agent_sandboxes` | Gauge | Monitor the point-in-time number of sandboxes in the cluster. | `namespace`, `ready_condition`, `expired`, `launch_type`, `sandbox_template`, `owned_by`, `created_by` |
